curriculum.subject: English Language Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: use words related to greetings in everyday conversations

interactions.prompt: Amani meets his teacher in the morning. What should he say?
interactions.feedback: Yes! We say Good morning when we meet someone early in the day.
interactions.retryHint: Look at the morning sun and choose the morning greeting.

interactions.prompt: Zuri says, Hello! Choose the friendly reply.
interactions.feedback: Great! Hello is a friendly greeting and reply.
interactions.retryHint: Reply with the same friendly greeting.

interactions.prompt: It is afternoon at the school gate. Choose the best greeting.
interactions.feedback: Correct! Good afternoon fits this time of day.
interactions.retryHint: The sun is high and morning has passed.

interactions.prompt: Neema asks, How are you? Choose a polite answer.
interactions.feedback: Well done! That answer keeps the conversation friendly.
interactions.retryHint: Choose the answer that tells Neema how you feel.

interactions.prompt: You are leaving your friend after a football game. What do you say?
interactions.feedback: Exactly! Goodbye is used when people part.
interactions.retryHint: Choose the word used when leaving.

interactions.prompt: Complete the conversation: Musa: Good evening, Wanjiku. Wanjiku: ____
interactions.feedback: Excellent! You used the right greeting in a conversation.
interactions.retryHint: Reply using the same time-of-day greeting.
